# CARDS — the card ledger (generated by `gen-card-ledger.js`; do not edit by hand)

Bot v0.6.241 · `gen-card-ledger.js` v1.3.0 · `gen-deck-coverage.js` v1.1.56 · cardfx 221 curated / 1696 library entries with effects · 18 decks (banuhaqim, brujah, gangrel, hecata, lasombra, malkavian, ministry, nosferatu, pathcaine, pathcathari, pathdeath, pathpower, ravnos, salubri, toreador, tremere, tzimisce, ventrue) · rulings from vtes.json.

Sim: `fin-240` — 240 matches, bot v0.6.241 on client v2.6.179, malkavian,tremere,nosferatu,ventrue, every seating × 10 deal(s) from seed 1 · 14 dirs (`banuhaqim`, `brujah`, `gangrel`, `hecata`, `lasombra`, `ministry`, `pathcaine`, `pathcathari`, `pathdeath`, `pathpower`, `ravnos`, `salubri`, `toreador`, `tzimisce`) — 168 matches, bot v0.6.241 on client v2.6.179, each its own deck + malkavian,tremere,nosferatu,ventrue, random seatings from seed 1.

**Status:** playable = the bot plays every mode it can reach and some deck played the card in the sim (per deck below: that deck did) · unseen = it could, its decks sat, it never did (a pricing question first, LESSONS L-9) · not seated = it could, but none of its decks sat in the sims given · playable (static) = it could, and no sim was given · partial = some modes, or a master played blind · inert = nothing the bot reads · unresolved = the name finds no card. **Uses** = decisions to play the card from hand (action picks, and a master pick once it was played: its own row, or gone from the hand by the next decide row of that bot) plus every card play the bot emits in a window, counted in the deck that played it, over the matches that deck sat in. A verdict is static (what the code CAN do); uses are what the table DID (L-47).

**Fidelity** (v1.3.0, RULINGS D-138): playable is *reach* -- it cannot see a clause an entry leaves out. **text-checked** = the copies whose card's entry was read clause by clause against KRCG's text (`cardfx-fidelity.json`); **exact** = of those, the ones playable in the deck with no open `docs/SWEEP-REGISTER.md` entry that changes the card's own play (active, missed, reachable; a latent gap, a human's play and a trace debt do not count). The ledger's last column lists a checked card's gaps by register id and state. An unchecked copy is not exact: its entry may be right, but no one has read it.

## The crypt (every vampire; RULINGS D-108)

Read from KRCG's text (`vtes.json`): 186 vampires, 216 crypt copies -- a row in the crypt ledger below for each vampire with an ability, the sect-and-title-only ones listed per deck after it. **Status:** no ability = sect and title only (a title is data the bot reads, R-31) · modelled = a curated crypt `fx` whose every key a crypt reader of the bot reads and whose keys' classes cover every sentence · partial = a key no crypt reader reads, or a sentence no key covers (the row says which) · unmodelled = an ability and no `fx` · unresolved = no KRCG text for the name. A deck joins the menu when its library rows play, its crypt rows are no ability or modelled, and it holds up in the sim (D-98, D-108). **Class (kind)** per sentence of the ability: passive = a bare "+1 bleed." · activated = "... can ..." · conditional = the rest (a condition, a toll, a grant). The classifier gives 51 of 51 curated crypt entries (every one with an `fx`) the classes of their keys.

**The crypt readers** (scanned from `elysium-bot.js`: each `this._cryptFxOf(` call, the `fx.<key>` it reads and the method it sits in -- the mechanism that models a key; that it applies an entry's form, a `when` or a condition, is the wave's section test): `bleedBonus` → `_cryptBleedBonus` · `bleedBoostDiscard` → `_cryptBleedBoostFx` · `blockNotOlder` → `_cryptCannotBlock` · `burnAtDamage` → `_takenLine` / `_resolveCombatRound` · `burnOnTorpor` → `_fameTorporHook` · `enterPlay` → `_maybeEnterPlayDraw` · `interceptMod` → `_cryptIntercept` · `noHuntStealth` → `_undirectedBaseStealth` · `noUnlockAfterTitledBleed` → `_maybeLubomiraMark` · `selfUnlock` → `_cryptSelfUnlockFx` · `stealthMod` → `_cryptStealthMod` · `strengthMod` → `_cryptStrengthMod` · `strikeDodge` → `_cryptDodgeFx` · `voteBoostDiscard` → `_cryptVoteBoostFx` · `voteTaxAgainst` → `_cryptVoteTax`.
